layout.name: XY Chart
layout.layoutData:
<# var msg = tw.resource.toolkit.TWSYS.ChartMessages; #>

chart {
	3D : "false";
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
	backgroundPaint : "#ffffffff";
	border : "@#border14";
	header : "@#label12";
	name : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.XY.name") #>";
	opaque : "true";
	preferredSize : "414,301";
	renderingType : "SCATTER";
	sampleSeries[0] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.XY.lineSet1.text") #>,(12.5,27),(44.567,50):LINE";
	sampleSeries[1] : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.XY.lineSet2.text") #>,(-20,50),(10,-30):LINE";
	XGridVisible : "true";
	yAxis1 : "true,false";
	YGridVisible : "true";
}

chartGrid {
	majorPaint : "#ffd3d3d3";
	majorStroke : "@=stroke11";
}

chartLegend {
	antiAliasing : "true";
	antiAliasingText : "true";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] {
	autoDataRange : "false";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	stepsDefinition : "@#stepsDefinition6";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
	titleRotation : "-0.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="-1"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
	dataMax : "150.0";
	dataMin : "-150.0";
}



chartScale[axisIndex="0"] {
	autoDataRange : "false";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	labelColor : "#ff000000";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	stepsDefinition : "@#stepsDefinition8";
	titleColor : "#ff000000";
	titleRotation : "-0.0";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="0"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
	dataMax : "150.0";
	dataMin : "-150.0";
}



chartScale[axisIndex="1"] {
	autoDataRange : "false";
	labelFont : "SansSerif-10";
	labelRotation : "0";
	majorTickVisible : "true";
	stepsDefinition : "@#stepsDefinition10";
}

chartScale[axisIndex="1"] axis {
	autoVisibleRange : "true";
	dataMax : "150.0";
	dataMin : "-150.0";
}



series[index="0"] {
	color1 : "#FF005699";
	color2 : "#ff0000ff";
	marker : "CIRCLE";
	markerSize : "10";
	renderingType : "AREA";
	stroke : "@#stroke1";
}

series[index="1"] {
	color1 : "#FFdace98";
	color2 : "#ff0000ff";
	marker : "SQUARE";
	markerSize : "3";
	renderingType : "POLYLINE";
	stroke : "@#stroke2";
}

Subobject#border13 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#border14 {
	bottom : "0";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "0";
	right : "0";
	top : "0";
}

Subobject#border4 {
	bottom : "1";
	class : "javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder(top,left,bottom,right)";
	left : "1";
	right : "1";
	top : "1";
}

Subobject#label12 {
	border : "@#border13";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.XY.header") #>";
}

Subobject#label3 {
	border : "@#border4";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.swing.IlvJLabel";
	font : "SansSerif-12";
	foreground : "#ff000000";
	horizontalAlignment : "0";
	text : "<#= msg.getChartDefString("chart.XY.header") #>";
}

Subobject#stepsDefinition10 {
	autoStepUnit : "false";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.IlvDefaultStepsDefinition";
	stepUnit : "25";
}

Subobject#stepsDefinition6 {
	autoStepUnit : "false";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.IlvDefaultStepsDefinition";
	stepUnit : "25";
}

Subobject#stepsDefinition8 {
	autoStepUnit : "false";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.IlvDefaultStepsDefinition";
	stepUnit : "25";
}

Subobject#stepsDefinition9 {
	autoStepUnit : "false";
	class : "ilog.views.chart.IlvDefaultStepsDefinition";
	stepUnit : "250";
}

Subobject#stroke1 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke11 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashArray[0] : "4";
	dashArray[1] : "4";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}

Subobject#stroke2 {
	class : "java.awt.BasicStroke(lineWidth,endCap,lineJoin,miterLimit,dashArray,dashPhase)";
	dashPhase : "0.0";
	endCap : "0";
	lineJoin : "2";
	lineWidth : "1";
	miterLimit : "3.732051";
}
